name: Messy Data Trust Engine

canonical.title: Messy Data Trust X-Ray
canonical.job: Show what happened to messy data before anyone relies on it.
canonical.bWeb: Records normalize, deduplicate and retain reversible provenance.

rules: trim source identity while retaining the raw snapshot
normalize spacing and case with named versioned rules
strictly parse rather than coerce currency values
validate emails before they can drive candidate grouping
group exact valid normalized emails only as possible duplicates
bind each review to the exact candidate IDs, actor, date, evidence, rationale, and decision
require a Build 011 identity-resolution reference before recording confirmed-same-entity
never merge, overwrite, or delete a source record

nonClaims: Traceability does not establish source truth.
A duplicate candidate or review is not proof of identity.
Normalization is not a legal, statistical, or fitness-for-use determination.
TRACEABLE does not authorize migration, merging, or reliance.
